appearance_facts.fact: Title reads 'Married couple vs Single women'.
Blue solid line with circular markers is labeled 'Married couple' (left axis).
Red dashed line with square markers is labeled 'Single women' (right axis).
At the 2020 x-position, the red square marker (Single women) is near the top of the plot, while the blue circular marker (Married couple) is near the bottom.

public_definitions: Compare the 2020 group count for Married couple and Single women.
Open the population group follow-up record for the group with the larger 2020 count.
uncertain: The chart uses dual y-axes (left for Married couple, right for Single women) with no visible tick values, so the absolute 2020 counts cannot be read numerically; only relative vertical positions are visible.
No numeric annotation is printed at the 2020 markers for either series.
